description: Download a binary Google Drive file (PDF, image, zip, Office doc, etc.) into blob storage. Runs as a background job: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the file_blob_key, name, and mime type arrive via a follow-up message once the download completes. Google-native docs (Docs/Sheets/Slides) cannot be downloaded this way — use the matching export verb instead. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Fetch a binary Drive file's bytes and persist them to platform blob storage as a background job, returning a job_id for tracking; completion delivers a blob key plus the file's name and mime type. Handles arbitrary uploaded binaries. Google-native documents, spreadsheets and presentations each have a dedicated export verb, which is how those leave Drive as files.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the Drive download; completion will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job to download a binary Drive file into blob storage.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id, missing session_id/flow_id context, or the file is a Google-native doc that must be exported. gsuite.not_found: the id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.api_error: AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: pass a valid binary-file id, or use the export verb for native docs. gsuite.not_found: the file may have been deleted. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error: retry once platform startup has completed.
